name: Jedney Gas Processing Plant and Pipeline Facilities

commitments.text:
1.  WGSI shall cause the Project to be designed, located, constructed and operated in accordance with the documents listed in Schedule A to 
this Certificate, collectively comprising the proponent’s application.

4.  WGSI must ensure, prior to discharge of any acid gas from the gas processing plant, that Petro-Canada obtain approval from the Ministry 
of Employment and Investment under the Petroleum and natural Gas Act for the proposed acid gas disposal scheme at either of the acid 
gas disposal wells at a-79-J/94-G-1 or b-88- J/94-G-1.

5.  WGSI must fulfill all commitments and proposed mitigation measures as documented in the application, including supplementary 
documents and correspondence as listed in Schedule A to this Certificate.

6.  WGSI must construct the sales gas pipeline along the “mid” route as diagrammed in Schedule B to this Certificate, highlighted in yellow, 
and described in the application.

7.  (a) If WGSI requires a variation outlined in respect of: 
(i) the acid gas disposal scheme as documented in Schedule A to this Certificate;
(ii) the location of the gas processing plant outside the boundary of the site as proposed by WGSI and documented in 
Schedule A to this Certificate; or
(iii) the location of the sales gas pipeline along a corridor other than the“mid”route as diagrammed in Schedule B to 
this Certificate;
WGSI must make an application for such variation to the Executive Director;
(b) The Executive Director, on receipt of the application for a variation referred to in Condition 7(a):
(i) may make a recommendation to the Minister and the Minister of Employment and Investment as to a review process necessary 
for effective assessment of the potential effects of the variation proposed, and where the effects are potentially adverse, whether 
those effects may be mitigated;
(ii) on approval by the Minister and the Minister of Employment and Investment as to the proposed review process, must establish 
that review process and cause it to be conducted; and
(iii)on conclusion of the review process, must make a recommendation to the Minister and the Minister of Employment and 
Investment regarding the variation;
(c) On receipt of the recommendation of the Executive Director, the Minister with the concurrence of the Minister of Employment and Investment, 
may vary this certificate.

8. Prior to construction of the sales gas pipeline, WGSI must complete a route walk with members of the Blueberry River Indian Band and 
Halfway River Band in order to adjust the final alignments of the sales gas pipeline route to avoid adverse impacts on traditional uses.

9. WGSI must, to the satisfaction of the Director of the Archaeology Branch, Ministry of Small Business, Tourism & Culture, to ensure that the 
potential archaeological impacts, including those identified in Schedule A to this Certificate, are prevented:
(i) complete an archaeological inventory prior to ground disturbing activities in any area with archaeological potential; and

9. WGSI must, to the satisfaction of the Director of the Archaeology Branch, Ministry of Small Business, Tourism & Culture, to ensure that the 
potential archaeological impacts, including those identified in Schedule A to this Certificate, are prevented:
(ii) then must implement a monitoring and reporting program.

10. WGSI must, in the reasonable opinion of the Minister, have substantially started and constructed the Project within five years of the issue date 
of this Certificate.
